Cisco CBS350-8S-E-2G 10-Port Gigabit Managed Switch

The Cisco CBS350-8S-E-2G is a 10-port managed switch designed to quickly expand a business's network capacity. It features eight Gigabit SFP slots that can connect to a range of wired devices such as computers and network-attached storage, as well as two Gigabit SFP/RJ45 combo ports for high-speed uplink connections. This switch has extensive Layer 2 and Layer 3 features that include secure connections, clear communications, and link aggregation for up to eight groups of ports. The switch also has advanced defense mechanisms, including IEEE 802.1x and port security to limit access to specific segments of the network. Web-based authentication provides a consistent interface to all types of host devices and operating systems, while dynamic Address Resolution Protocol (ARP) inspection, IP Source Guard, and Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) snooping help detect and block network attacks. The switch supports the IPv6 First Hop Security suite, which includes ND inspection, RA guard, DHCPv6 guard, and neighbor binding integrity check, to protect against address spoofing and man-in-the-middle attacks. The Cisco CBS350-8S-E-2G switch has a switching capacity of 20 Gbps and a memory of 512 MB. It uses a store-and-forward transmission method and has indicator lights for link/activity, speed, and system. The switch is fanless and has a mean time between failure (MTBF) of 2242229 hours. It is designed to fit in a 1 RU rack and has a dimension of 280 x 170 x 44mm, with a weight of 1 kg. The switch has a white body color and can be powered with 100 to 240 VAC, 50/60 Hz. The switch allows for network evolution using the IPv6 standard while remaining compatible with previous-generation IPv4 networks.

TP-Link Omada SG6428X 24-Port Gigabit Stackable L3 Managed Switch with SFP Port

The TP-Link Omada SG6428X 24-Port Gigabit Stackable L3 Managed Switch with SFP Port is a high-performance enterprise networking solution. Built for SMBs, enterprises, and ISPs that need scalable, reliable, and feature-rich Layer 3 switching at the network convergence layer. It delivers 128 Gbps switching capacity per unit with 24 Gigabit RJ45 ports and four 10 Gbps SFP+ slots for fast and flexible wired connectivity. This TP-Link Omada SG6428X 24-Port Gigabit Managed Switch supports physical stacking of up to 8 units, dual redundant power supplies, and full Omada SDN integration for centralized cloud management.

Port Configuration

The TP-Link Omada SG6428X 24-Port Gigabit Switch provides 24 10/100/1000 Mbps RJ45 ports and four 10G SFP+ slots for high-density wired connectivity across enterprise network deployments. A switching capacity of 128 Gbps per unit and a packet forwarding rate of 95.2 Mpps ensure the switch handles demanding traffic loads without bottlenecks during peak operation. A 32K MAC address table, 3MB packet buffer memory, and 9KB jumbo frame support enable efficient and high-volume data processing across all connected devices. Two USB 2.0 ports, one RJ45 console port, one USB Type-C console port, and one dedicated RJ45 management port provide comprehensive access and configuration options.

Switching Performance

Physical stacking supports up to 4 units per stack group with each 10G SFP+ uplink port usable as a stacking port at 20 Gbps full-duplex stack bandwidth. This stacking capability scales the network to 8 units for built-in redundancy and expanded port density without complex configuration changes. The TP-Link Omada SG6428X 24-Port Gigabit Managed Switch uses Store-and-Forward transmission for reliable and error-free packet delivery across all connected network segments. Four internal fixed fans and a maximum power consumption of 28.4W at 220V ensure efficient and thermally managed continuous operation.

Layer 3 Routing

The TP-Link Omada SG6428X 24-Port Switch delivers comprehensive Layer 3 routing capabilities including Static Routing, RIP v1/v2, OSPF v2/v3, ECMP with up to 32 nexthops per destination, VRRP v2/v3, and DHCP Server and Relay for scalable network architectures. IPv4 supports up to 256 IP interfaces, 1024 static routes, and a host route table of up to 6100 entries for extensive routing table capacity. PIM-DM and PIM-SM multicast routing protocols ensure efficient multicast traffic delivery across complex network topologies. DHCP Server supports up to 8K IP pools and 1000 manual binding entries for comprehensive address management in large network deployments.

Layer 2 Features

With Layer 2 features include Link Aggregation, Spanning Tree Protocol, ERPS for ring topology protection and recovery, Port Mirroring, RSPAN, and 802.3x Flow Control for robust and resilient network operation. IGMP Snooping, MLD Snooping, Multicast VLAN Registration, and support for 2048 IGMP groups deliver efficient multicast traffic management across the network. Up to 4K VLAN groups using 802.1Q, MAC VLAN, Protocol VLAN, QinQ, Voice VLAN, Private VLAN, and GVRP provide extensive traffic segmentation capabilities. The TP-Link Managed Switch also supports 802.3ah Ethernet Link OAM, L2PT, DLDP, DDM, and sFlow for comprehensive ISP-grade feature coverage.

products.description:
TP-Link TL-SG1016DE 16-Port Gigabit Easy Smart Switch

The TP-Link TL-SG1016DE 16-Port Gigabit Easy Smart Switch is a cost-effective network upgrade for simple management beyond basic plug-and-play switching. The Switch provides 16 10/100/1000 Mbps RJ45 ports with AUTO Negotiation and AUTO MDI/MDIX on every port for effortless connectivity. This TP-Link TL-SG1016DE Switch delivers a 32 Gbps switching capacity and a 23.8 Mpps packet forwarding rate for fast and reliable network throughput.

16 Gigabit Port

The TP-Link TL-SG1016DE 16-Port Gigabit Switch delivers 32 Gbps switching capacity and a 23.8 Mpps packet forwarding rate across all 16 Gigabit RJ45 ports simultaneously. An 8K MAC address table and 4.1 Mbit packet buffer memory ensure efficient traffic handling and minimal packet loss under busy network conditions. Jumbo frame support up to 10KB allows large data transfers across the network without fragmentation or performance degradation. The switch supports 10BASE-T, 100BASE-TX, and 1000BASE-T network media standards with cable runs up to 100 meters on appropriate UTP or STP cabling.

QoS and Traffic Management

The TP-Link TL-SG1016DE 16-Port Gigabit Easy Smart Switch supports Port-based, 802.1p, and DSCP priority modes with four priority queues for precise and flexible traffic prioritization. Rate Limiting and Storm Control features actively manage bandwidth usage and protect the network from broadcast, multicast, and unknown-unicast traffic flooding. These QoS tools ensure latency-sensitive applications like VoIP and video conferencing always receive sufficient network resources for smooth and jitter-free operation.

VLAN and Network Segmentation

The TP-Link TL-SG1016DE 16-Port Switch supports up to 32 VLANs simultaneously from a pool of 4096 VLAN IDs using MTU VLAN, Port-based VLAN, and 802.1Q Tag-based VLAN configurations. VLAN segmentation improves network security by isolating traffic between different departments, user groups, and device categories across the business network. This segmentation also reduces unnecessary broadcast traffic and improves overall network performance for all connected users simultaneously.

products.description:
Zyxel MES 3500-24F 24-port FE Fiber L2 Switch with Four GbE Combo Port

Consistent service quality and reliable connecting ability in a converged network is the key for Carrier to connect and satisfy customers; therefore the ability to control traffic flow and set traffic policy becomes more critical than ever. The Zyxel MES3500 series offers wire-speed flow control that classifies and prioritizes the incoming packets according to the predefine QoS policies that meet the requirements of service providers. In terms of classification, the Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) field and the 802.1p Class of Service (CoS) field are identified to assess the priority of incoming packets. Classification and reclassification can be based on criteria as specific as rules based on IP, MAC addresses, VLAN ID, or TCP/UDP port number. For bandwidth management, the MES3500 series provides 8 priority queues per port for different types of traffics, allowing service providers to set policy-based rate limitations that take full advantage of constrained network resources and guarantee the best performance. Avoiding subscribers affecting each other on a shared network or shared device is a major concern for service providers. The Zyxel MES3500 series offers a complete set of security features to protect user data while administrating the traffics. Port security provides the ability to deny unauthorized users from accessing the network. Moreover, the 802.1X feature cooperating with RADIUS is useful to prevent unauthorized access based on username and password (or other credentials) and acts as powerful access control for converged networks with mixed wired and wireless access. The MES3500 series provides a multilayer (L2/L3/L4) ACL suite of sophisticated policy-based control mechanisms that enables service providers to deploy easily based on actual network environment needs via a Web GUI or command-line interface to prevent abnormal or illegal access. The policies can be defined to deny packets based on source and destination MAC addresses, IP addresses, or TCP/UDP ports. A quick recovery and round-the-clock network are vital for service providers to establish a robust network. The MES3500 series provides comprehensive features to make sure the network is well operated. The IEEE 802.3ad Link Aggregation feature reduces network downtime by providing redundant paths and bandwidth aggregation to critical connections, while IEEE 802.1w Rapid Spanning Tree Protocol (RSTP) and IEEE 802.1s Multiple Spanning Tree Protocol (MSTP) allow immediate recovery from failed connections by sending packets via the backup link. The enhanced digital interface allows real-time access to the device operating parameters, and it includes optional digital features such as soft control and monitoring of SFP I/O signals. In addition, the MES3500 series fully incorporates the functionality needed to implement digital alarms and warnings from fault isolation and failure prediction tasks as well as component monitoring features, among others. With the digital diagnostic monitoring interface, the MES3500 series enables users to easily detect packet loss from transceivers and aging cables; therefore users can not only avoid troubles such as unstable networking services but also boost productivity significantly. As Zyxel considers IPv6 management features as a future trend, complete IPv6 host management capabilities are added to the MES3500 series for guaranteed IPv6/4 migration and future-proof expansion. Itâ€™s not only beneficial for high-density Fast Ethernet deployments but also capable of preventing investment loss and therefore perfectly suitable for both network cores and edges.
